news.title: Deezer’s new tool can identify AI music from Spotify, Apple Music, and others
news.description: Deezer introduced a tool that scans playlists from Spotify, Apple Music, and other platforms to identify AI music.

news.title: DoorDash’s new AI chatbot lets you order with prompts and photos
news.description: The new chatbot, called Ask DoorDash, allows users to search the app for what they're looking for in their own words instead of having to scroll through restaurants and stores to build a cart.

news.title: Kalshi to make some users reveal job details to tackle insider trading
news.description: After issues with insider trading, the prediction betting platform is adding new rules.

news.title: Version of AI tool 'too powerful for public' released to public
news.description: Claude Fable 5 is a version of Anthropic's Claude Mythos, an AI program which caused a stir among technology, finance, and government leaders.

news.title: Farage says Reform has contacted X 'to highest level' over fake AI ads
news.description: The fake ads feature the governor of the Bank of England - the Bank has urged people to report them.

news.title: Meet the OpenAI Engineer Leading ChatGPT's Biggest Transformation Yet
news.description: Thibault Sottiaux helped make AI coding one of OpenAI’s fastest-growing businesses. Now he’s overseeing a sweeping overhaul of ChatGPT.

news.title: Anthropic Walks Back Policy That Could Have ‘Sabotaged’ AI Researchers Using Claude
news.description: The company changed course after researchers spoke out against the policy, which would have covertly limited Claude’s ability to develop competing AI models.

news.title: Wrongful Arrest Exposes Failures in One of the Oldest Police Face-Recognition Tools in the US
news.description: The ACLU is suing two Florida police departments over the arrest of a Fort Myers man in a child-abduction case, saying officers treated a flawed face-recognition match as a near-certain ID.
